general:
STYLE GUIDE:
- Voice: first person, accountable, specific, evidence-based.
- Structure: Situation -> Action -> Outcome -> Reflection.
- Evidence: include scope, metrics, and stakeholder impact where available.
- Balance: cover technical delivery quality and consulting/collaboration impact.
- CatalystFlow values: briefly show ownership, initiative, teamwork, and growth mindset through actions.
Software / DevOps Engineering:
STYLE GUIDE (Software/DevOps):
- Voice: concise, technical, outcome-oriented, avoids buzzwords.
- Structure by answer: Context -> What I changed -> Why this approach -> Result.
- Technology/Core Skills cues: architecture decisions, reliability/performance/security improvements, automation, operational excellence, and trade-off reasoning.
- Consulting Skills cues: stakeholder alignment, cross-team communication, influencing decisions, and delivery against business goals.
- CatalystFlow values cues: ownership under ambiguity, proactive risk management, mentoring, and continuous improvement.
- Evidence: name systems/tools, quantify impact (latency, uptime, incidents, delivery speed, cost), and call out who benefited.
Data:
STYLE GUIDE (Data):
- Voice: analytical and clear, ties technical choices to business outcomes.
- Structure: Problem -> Analysis/Modeling approach -> Decision -> Impact.
- Technology/Core Skills cues: data quality, experiment design, modeling/analytics trade-offs, reproducibility, and platform/tooling rigor.
- Consulting Skills cues: translating findings for non-technical stakeholders, prioritization, and decision support.
- CatalystFlow values cues: curiosity, ownership, collaboration, and coaching through knowledge sharing.
- Evidence: cite metrics, baselines, confidence/limitations, and downstream impact.
Quality Engineering:
STYLE GUIDE (Quality Engineering):
- Voice: risk-aware, systematic, and delivery-focused.
- Structure: Risk/quality goal -> Strategy -> Execution -> Outcome.
- Technology/Core Skills cues: test architecture, automation depth, quality gates, defect prevention, and CI/CD quality signals.
- Consulting Skills cues: influencing quality standards, partnering with engineers/product, and communicating trade-offs.
- CatalystFlow values cues: accountability for quality outcomes, continuous improvement, and team enablement.
- Evidence: include defect trends, escape rate changes, cycle-time effects, confidence improvements, and stakeholder outcomes.
